pieces.Text: You instinctively react to interfere with foes that attack your allies or innocents.

Whenever an opponent you threaten makes an attack against a helpless, prone, or stunned ally or any attack against a noncombatant, that opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you. If your attack of opportunity hits your foe, she takes a -4 penalty on the attack roll that provoked this attack of opportunity.

Situational.text: Prerequisites: Combat Reflexes, worshiper of Kurgess.
